name: phone-bridge
description: Send ZCode status pings to a user-supplied Telegram chat (bot token + chat id in a local 0600 config file): setup guidance, start/done/failed notifications with exit codes and output tails, and a waiting-for-you ping so the user can answer in the normal chat from their phone. Outbound only by design: no inbound control channel, no remote shell, no auto-approval.
